name: Salt Road Cemetery
description: An established cemetery beside the safe road. Settled older grave rows and a few recent burials surround a small chapel. A low wrought-iron enclosure, clear gate and maintained paths give it the character of a place used by the nearby settlement.

location.hint: Survey the existing cemetery beside the Salt Road and protect the current road corridor.

requirements: A small chapel with a reachable entrance and measured interior.
A low wrought-iron boundary set back from the road, with a clear working entrance.
Mostly older settled graves; reserve fresh earth for a few recent or disturbed burials.
Religious markers and any basin must have a clear use and relationship to the chapel or burial activity.
constraints: Preserve the established road and its usable travel width.
Use fitted planes and generated fence artwork if suitable for the game's art style; otherwise choose an appropriate mesh construction.
Respect current character, building and prop scale.
This is an illustrative plan brief, not an instruction to alter the frozen world. Size and hostility are example values, not newly accepted choices for the live cemetery.
